principle: The page follows the buyer's decision sequence: recognize, orient, explore, compare, verify, personalize, contact, deepen.

sections.label: Portal header
sections.desktop: 72px sticky bar; project navigation remains secondary to the showroom CTA.
sections.mobile: 56px compact bar; no mega-menu over the hero.
sections.whyHere: The visitor must recognize NadLan as a broad portal before entering the project-specific journey.
sections.seoRole: Site identity and crawlable navigation.
sections.conversionRole: Provides trust and an escape route without competing with apartment selection.

sections.label: Clickable breadcrumbs
sections.desktop: Directly below the global header, 16px above the hero title.
sections.mobile: Single-line horizontal scroller; current item never becomes a link.
sections.whyHere: It establishes portal hierarchy and separates project, neighborhood and city intents before the H1.
sections.seoRole: Home > New projects > Sde Dov > Aurelia; mirrored in BreadcrumbList schema.
sections.conversionRole: Lets exploratory buyers widen the search without abandoning the portal.

sections.label: Identity and first decision
sections.desktop: Two-column 60/40 composition; building image at least 560px high; text aligned to first visible façade line.
sections.mobile: Building image occupies the first visual fold; title and CTA follow without an overlay card hiding the tower.
sections.whyHere: The first five seconds answer what, where, scale and what the visitor can do next.
sections.seoRole: One H1, bilingual project name, Sde Dov, developer entity, status and concise promise.
sections.conversionRole: Primary CTA opens apartment selection; secondary CTA opens project materials or meeting.

sections.label: Search-answer opening paragraph
sections.desktop: Immediately below hero actions; maximum 780px text measure.
sections.mobile: Visible before the progress bar; 3-5 short sentences.
sections.whyHere: The page must answer the search intent before interactive complexity begins.
sections.seoRole: Contains project names, Sde Dov, developer, project type, status, apartment range and price range in natural language.
sections.conversionRole: Confirms relevance and gives enough facts to justify interaction.

sections.label: Project and journey progress
sections.desktop: Full-width strip between opening answer and decision cockpit; 64px high.
sections.mobile: Four equal stages plus one active journey label; never sticky over the building.
sections.whyHere: It separates project delivery status from the buyer's next action and sets expectations before selection.
sections.seoRole: Visible status text, not an icon-only component.
sections.conversionRole: Reduces uncertainty about stage and availability.

sections.label: Decision facts rail
sections.desktop: Six compact cards above the showroom, 16px gap.
sections.mobile: Horizontal snap rail; first three facts visible as a cue to swipe.
sections.whyHere: High-signal facts should be scannable before a buyer invests attention in the model.
sections.seoRole: Plain text facts repeated later in structured content without keyword stuffing.
sections.conversionRole: Supports rapid qualification by scale, unit mix, location, status, price and delivery.

sections.label: Showroom promise and controls
sections.desktop: Section title, one sentence and control legend above the 3D stage.
sections.mobile: Title and one-line instruction; no tutorial wall.
sections.whyHere: The user must know that the model is a decision tool, not decoration.
sections.seoRole: Introduces selection, plans, views and prices as visible capabilities.
sections.conversionRole: Invites the exact behavior that historically produced the qualified lead.

sections.label: 3D inventory and filters
sections.desktop: 70/30 stage and side panel; building remains centered when the panel changes.
sections.mobile: Full-width stage above a compact bottom card; building remains visible in every selected state.
sections.whyHere: Apartment choice is the core money journey and must precede long editorial content.
sections.seoRole: Unit facts are rendered as accessible text; no indexable thin URL per unit by default.
sections.conversionRole: Filters and hotspots turn interest into a specific apartment context.

sections.label: Selected apartment card
sections.desktop: Persistent side panel within the showroom, never covering the façade.
sections.mobile: Compact card below the visible model; no expanded drawer state.
sections.whyHere: Every downstream tool needs an explicit, persistent unit identity.
sections.seoRole: Facts are user-selected interface content, not duplicated as competing pages.
sections.conversionRole: Shows floor, direction, area, balcony, price and the four next actions.

sections.label: Apartment plan
sections.desktop: Opens inside the showroom stage with zoom and a unit facts rail.
sections.mobile: Full stage, pinch/zoom controls and a fixed 44px close control; returns to selected unit.
sections.whyHere: The plan answers fit and layout immediately after unit qualification.
sections.seoRole: Descriptive alt text and visible plan metadata.
sections.conversionRole: Provides the artifact most requested by qualified leads.

sections.label: Window view, direction beam and map
sections.desktop: Panorama and map shown together; selected unit is the beam origin.
sections.mobile: Panorama first, then compact live map; one control turns view and beam together.
sections.whyHere: After fit, buyers ask what they see and how the apartment sits in the neighborhood.
sections.seoRole: Visible direction and named landmarks support local relevance without creating map-only content.
sections.conversionRole: Transforms abstract orientation into an emotional and geographic decision.

sections.label: Interactive interior tour
sections.desktop: 360 stage with room hotspots and unit context always visible.
sections.mobile: Drag panorama with three clear room hotspots and no hidden close gesture.
sections.whyHere: The user has selected and located the apartment; now the page lets them inhabit it.
sections.seoRole: Room names and apartment facts remain visible around the canvas.
sections.conversionRole: Builds confidence and leads naturally into personalization.

sections.label: Facilities as selectable spaces
sections.desktop: Facility map/model with hotspots; detail panel on selection.
sections.mobile: Horizontal facility controls above image; selected card below image.
sections.whyHere: Facilities become meaningful only after the apartment journey establishes personal relevance.
sections.seoRole: Every facility has a visible name, location and operational description.
sections.conversionRole: Lets buyers evaluate daily use, not a list of marketing icons.

sections.label: Sde Dov decision map and aerial tour
sections.desktop: Interactive map and aerial context with classified points.
sections.mobile: Map height 420px; category chips remain outside map gestures.
sections.whyHere: The apartment and building are understood before evaluating the wider life around them.
sections.seoRole: Supports Sde Dov relevance and links to the canonical neighborhood guide.
sections.conversionRole: Answers beach, park, transport, education, retail and commute questions.

sections.label: Apartment specification studio
sections.desktop: Dedicated full-width work surface linked to plan and BOM.
sections.mobile: Step-by-step wizard; summary remains accessible without hiding the current choice.
sections.whyHere: Personalization follows understanding of the apartment, view and environment.
sections.seoRole: No thin indexable configuration URLs; public text explains the capability.
sections.conversionRole: Turns preference into a structured brief for the project team.

sections.label: Meeting, developer conversation and Co-tour
sections.desktop: Contextual module after studio, with unit and specification summary attached.
sections.mobile: Three explicit actions; no auto-open chat bubble over the showroom.
sections.whyHere: Human assistance is most valuable after the user has formed specific questions.
sections.seoRole: Not indexed as separate content.
sections.conversionRole: Preserves project, unit, plan, view and studio context in the conversation.

sections.label: 5,000-word decision article
sections.desktop: Narrow 780px reading column with sticky table of contents beside it.
sections.mobile: Collapsible table of contents; short paragraphs, tables and jump links.
sections.whyHere: Long-form depth supports validation after the primary tools have answered the immediate decision questions.
sections.seoRole: Owns project intent; neighborhood, developer and professional entities link to their canonical pages.
sections.conversionRole: Captures research-stage visitors and addresses objections in depth.

sections.label: Project team, facts and linked portal entities
sections.desktop: Entity cards and a structured fact table after the article.
sections.mobile: Stacked cards; every card has one canonical destination.
sections.whyHere: Entity depth strengthens trust without interrupting the apartment journey.
sections.seoRole: Developer, architect, contractor and consultants are linked to single entity owners.
sections.conversionRole: Lets sophisticated buyers verify the delivery team and specifications.

sections.label: Decision FAQ
sections.desktop: Question list after full evidence, before final appointment.
sections.mobile: Accessible disclosure controls with one answer open at a time.
sections.whyHere: FAQ resolves residual friction after the page has presented all primary evidence.
sections.seoRole: Questions mirror real search and lead language; FAQPage schema only when answers are visible.
sections.conversionRole: Closes remaining information gaps before contact.

sections.label: Final appointment and materials module
sections.desktop: Full-width high-contrast module before footer.
sections.mobile: Date and time selection in one column; persistent unit summary above submit.
sections.whyHere: The final conversion appears after tools and evidence, while contextual CTAs remain available earlier.
sections.seoRole: No crawl dependency; semantic form labels.
sections.conversionRole: Completes the decision journey with all selected context attached.
